source_snapshot.procedure: Prepare CIFS, open BMC WebUI/Remote Console, mount the network image as virtual CD/DVD, then notes that the ISO can be used for OS installation.
source_snapshot.criteria: Remote Console connects; the CD-ROM mounts to the server and an Auto-install program appears.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; operator mounts through WebUI and agent checks OS block devices.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: BLOCKED pending a choice among mount, boot-to-installer and installation.

old_problem: The source mixes host-side CIFS syntax, BMC virtual-media mounting and language about OS installation, without an installation target or completion oracle.
disposition_reason: The row title and the actual acceptance text require the image/CD-ROM to mount and the auto-install program to appear; neither requires launching or completing installation. The safe review boundary therefore ends at visual installer/launcher availability. Any boot-order change, installer continuation or disk write is separate destructive coverage and remains prohibited unless another approved test owns it.
decision_basis: Exact XLSX row 744, same-row DeepSeek, GPT V2 and historical review were read.
OpenBMC's virtual-media design exposes CIFS/HTTPS ISO/IMG media to the host as a virtual USB storage device; OS installation is a possible later use, not an inherent requirement of media insertion.
The criteria's verb `show up` supports presence/visibility, while no partitioning, target disk, installation steps or installed-OS oracle exists.
ED-35 prevents a mount check from claiming installation coverage, and ED-31/visual rules require genuine WebUI/Remote Console evidence.

test_case.test_name: Mount the approved CIFS ISO through BMC virtual media and verify host/installer visibility
test_case.purpose: Verify a secured CIFS-backed image can be selected in the actual BMC WebUI, presented as the expected virtual CD-ROM to the server, opened far enough for the installer/auto-install launcher to be visibly available, and then cleanly ejected without installing or writing host disks.
required_package: Exact CIFS server/share/image, immutable hash, read-only permissions and supported SMB dialect/security policy
BMC WebUI/Remote Console access and model-specific virtual-media procedure
Isolated SUT plus baseline boot order and full protected-disk inventory
Trusted OS read-only device tools and evidence destination outside the virtual media
test_case.test_command: Operator uses the actual BMC WebUI/Remote Console to activate virtual media and enter the approved CIFS image path. Agent may collect trusted pre/post `lsblk -o NAME,PATH,TYPE,SIZE,RO,FSTYPE,MOUNTPOINTS,MODEL,SERIAL` and mount evidence. Stop when the exact image is visible as virtual CD/DVD and the installer/launcher screen is displayed; do not select Install/Next or alter boot/storage. Eject/deactivate the media and verify device removal.
test_case.expected_result: Remote Console remains usable; WebUI reports the intended hashed CIFS image inserted; the server enumerates one matching read-only virtual optical device; the expected installer/auto-install entry screen is visible without starting installation; eject succeeds and the virtual device disappears with unchanged physical-disk/boot state and no unexpected logs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires correlated GUI evidence, exact-image identity, virtual CD-ROM enumeration, visible launcher and complete cleanup. FAIL covers wrong/unreadable media, console failure, unexpected boot/write, mount/eject error or residual device. Do not claim OS-installation PASS. If visibility would require continuing into a disk-changing installer, stop BLOCKED for execution.
safety_gate: Explicitly prohibit boot-order modification, installer continuation, partitioning and writes to every physical/OS/data disk
Use read-only share/image where supported and never place CIFS passwords in committed commands/logs
Validate SUT and image identities and maintain independent console/BMC recovery
Capture full storage baseline; stop immediately on installer auto-start beyond the approved landing screen
Always eject/deactivate once evidence is captured; no automatic retry
expected_evidence: CIFS endpoint/security metadata and image hash with credentials redacted
Actual WebUI/Remote Console screenshots for connect, image selection, mounted status and installer visibility
Pre/post/ejected host device inventory tying the virtual CD-ROM to the image
Unchanged physical disk/boot state, cleanup and BMC/host log health
test_case.recovery: If the media triggers an unintended boot or installer action, do not confirm any prompt. Preserve the console and device evidence, eject through the approved BMC path, restore only the pre-approved boot state, and escalate before rebooting or retrying.

source_conflict.preserved_original_conflict: Malformed CIFS example, skipped criterion numbers and installation wording remain unchanged in the Master.
source_conflict.resolution: Mount plus installer visibility satisfies the explicit title and `show up` criterion; actual installation is excluded and cannot be inferred.

blocked.reason: A reversible, observable and non-destructive end state is now defined; CIFS values are runtime prerequisites.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: CIFS share/image/security details, BMC virtual-media path, isolated SUT and storage baseline.
